what: every sampled transaction, as it is on the wire, given to the crates that Agave is built from (cost-check/), and the answers compared with the transaction's row in data/mainnet_txs.csv.gz
steps: those of calculate_priority_from_bytes and calculate_priority_and_cost in core/src/transaction_priority.rs, Agave v4.4.1; the limits, the cost and the fee come from the crates, and cost-check computes the reward as Bank::calculate_reward_and_burn_fee_details does and the priority as calculate_priority_and_cost does
features_source: data/features_mainnet.json: the features that solana feature status lists as inactive on mainnet
